user.title: Guava API app
user.description: This integration is unofficial and is not made or supported by Guava. Enter the key of your own Guava API app (see the README). A test key reaches Guava's sandbox patient; a live key reaches real profiles. Each person is a separate entry: add this integration once for each.

data.redirect_uri: Redirect URI (exactly as on the app)

authorize.title: Authorise in Guava
authorize.description:
1. [Open the Guava consent page]({url}). The link lasts 10 minutes.
2. Choose the person on the consent screen and approve.
3. The browser lands on a page that fails to load. That is expected.
4. Copy the URL from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Authorise {person} again
reauth_confirm.description: Guava no longer accepts this grant, so doses for {person} can't be logged. Continue to get a new consent link, and choose the same person on the consent screen.

medications.title: Buttons for {person}
medications.description: Each chosen medication gets a button that logs one dose. Presses of the same medication inside the cooldown are ignored, because the API cannot delete a dose.

error.par_failed: Guava rejected the request. Check the key, the redirect URI and that the app has the required scopes.
error.authorization_failed: That URL did not work, or the link expired. Use the new link above.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up.
abort.wrong_profile: That grant is for a different person. Choose the same person on the consent screen.

tag_links.title: NFC tag links for {person}
tag_links.description:
Each link is for one blank NFC tag.

{links}

1. Write the link to the tag as a URL record. For Android, add an Application record `com.guavahealth.app` so that it opens the Guava app.
2. Tap the tag on a phone signed in to Guava.
3. In Guava's setup, choose {person} and the medication named here. Guava stores that choice, so this page can't check it.

These tags log through the Guava app, not Home Assistant: the cooldown doesn't apply and no Home Assistant event fires.

log_dose.name: Log dose
log_dose.description: Logs a dose of the medication behind a Guava button. Only the Guava app can delete it.

log_medication.name: Log medication
log_medication.description: Logs a dose to Guava. Only the Guava app can delete it.

medication.name: Medication
medication.description: Name of an active medication. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored.

config_entry_id.name: Person
config_entry_id.description: Required when more than one person is set up.

time.name: Time
time.description: When it was taken. Defaults to now.

bypass_cooldown.name: Bypass cooldown
bypass_cooldown.description: Log even if the same medication was logged within the cooldown.

allow_new.name: Allow new medication
allow_new.description: Create the medication in Guava if the name is unknown. The API cannot remove it afterwards.
